evidence_slice: Bradford Council's adopted Shipley and Canal Road Corridor Area Action Plan was adopted on 12 December 2017 and forms part of the statutory Development Plan. The authority-hosted Open_Data/SCRC_AAP ArcGIS MapServer layer 1 is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer and its renderer includes site allocation DF1 under policy SCRC/SH1. Bradford's AAP housing delivery evidence identifies DF1 as Dock Lane, Canalside, with an area of 2.01 hectares, residential-led mixed use, 114 residential units and supporting business uses.
